                            {
                                "type": "search_result",
                                "url": "https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/noida/strange-that-homebuyers-who-have-paid-in-full-cant-register-flats-because-of-govt-builder-dispute-hc/articleshow/134950768.cms",
                                "title": "Strange that homebuyers who have paid in full can't register flats because of govt-builder dispute: Allahabad high court",
                                "snippet": "The Allahabad High Court has expressed concern over the situation where fully paid homebuyers are unable to register their flats due to a dispute between the builder and government agencies. The issue was highlighted in a plea filed by residents of Ajnara Homes in Greater Noida West. The court found it \"strange\" that buyers who fulfilled their financial obligations are being penalized because the real estate developer has failed to clear its dues to government bodies. In response, the court has directed the state government, Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority, and the Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (UP-RERA) to provide a clear plan of action to address this issue. The case underscores the continuing problems faced by homebuyers in India due to regulatory and developer-related delays.",

                    {
                        "type": "search_result_group",
                        "domain": "navbharattimes.indiatimes.com",
                        "entries": [
                            {
                                "type": "search_result",
                                "url": "https://navbharattimes.indiatimes.com/state/uttar-pradesh/noida/up-rera-alerts-homebuyers-advises-caution-regarding-payments/articleshow/134913542.cms",
                                "title": "घर खरीदने का है प्लान? ध्यान से पढ़िए UP RERA की ये नई चेतावनी, नहीं तो डूब सकती है गाढ़ी कमाई",
                                "snippet": "उत्तर प्रदेश रियल एस्टेट रेगुलेटरी अथॉरिटी (UP RERA) ने घर खरीदने की योजना बना रहे लोगों को महत्वपूर्ण चेतावनी जारी की है। RERA ने सलाह दी है कि ग्राहक किसी भी सूरत में बिल्डर को भुगतान सीधे किसी अलग खाते में न करें। भुगतान केवल उन्हीं खातों में किया जाए जो RERA में पंजीकृत हैं, ताकि खरीदार की गाढ़ी कमाई सुरक्षित रहे। यह चेतावनी इसलिए दी गई है क्योंकि कई बार बिल्डर ग्राहकों पर दबाव डालकर उन्हें गैर-पंजीकृत खातों में पैसा जमा करवाते हैं, जिससे भविष्य में धोखाधड़ी की संभावनाएं बढ़ जाती हैं। यदि किसी ग्राहक पर ऐसा दबाव डाला जाता है, तो उसे तुरंत RERA में शिकायत दर्ज करानी चाहिए। RERA का यह कदम उपभोक्ता हितों की रक्षा और पारदर्शिता बढ़ाने के लिए उठाया गया है, जिससे घर खरीदार सुरक्षित महसूस कर सकें और अपनी मेहनत की कमाई के नुकसान से बच सकें।",
                                "ref_id": {

            "id": "98595fb6-855f-4992-ad46-9a79ff7b9251",

            "content": {
                "content_type": "text",
                "parts": [
                    "## 1. RERA registration and approved completion date\n\n<box border radius=\"xl\" padding={4} gap={3}>\n  <row align=\"center\" gap={2}>\n    <icon name=\"shield-check\" size=\"xl\" color=\"success\"/>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      <title size=\"lg\">Elite X</title>\n      <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">UP-RERA registered residential project</text>\n    </box>\n    <badge color=\"success\">Registered</badge>\n  </row>\n  <divider/>\n  <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n    <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Registration number</text>\n    <title size=\"md\">UPRERAPRJ916631/02/2024</title>\n  </row>\n  <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n    <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Registration date</text>\n    <title size=\"md\">24 February 2024</title>\n  </row>\n  <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n    <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Declared completion</text>\n    <title size=\"md\">12 December 2028</title>\n  </row>\n  <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n    <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Registered promoter</text>\n    <title size=\"md\">Golfgreen Mansions Pvt. Ltd.</title>\n  </row>\n  <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"xs\">Source: official UP-RERA project record. <Cite refs={[\"turn824355view0\"]}/></text>\n  <text><Link url=\"https://www.up-rera.in/\" title=\"Verify on the official UP-RERA website\"/></text>\n</box>\n\nThe project is registered, and its public record currently shows a declared completion date of **12 December 2028**. That is the date on the record I checked; I did not find evidence in the retrieved official record of a later approved extension for Elite X. <Cite refs={[\"turn824355view0\",\"turn824355search2\"]}/>\n\nRegistration is a useful legal starting point, but it does not independently establish that the land is free of all disputes, that every approval remains valid, or that the developer will deliver on time.\n\n## 2. Current construction status\n\nThe latest quarterly progress figures I could verify from filings on record were for April–June 2026.\n\n<box border radius=\"xl\" padding={3} gap={3}>\n  <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Reported construction progress</text>\n  <title size=\"2xl\">30.21%</title>\n  <box background=\"surface-tertiary\" radius=\"full\" height=\"10px\" clip>\n    <box background=\"#0D9488\" radius=\"full\" height=\"10px\" width=\"30.21%\"/>\n  </box>\n  <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n    <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">April–June 2026 filing</text>\n    <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Q2 2026</text>\n  </row>\n  <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Source: quarterly progress information compiled from UP-RERA filings. <Cite refs={[\"turn824355view1\"]}/></text>\n</box>\n\nThe developer's website separately claims that the structure was approximately 42% complete in July 2026. That is a developer-published figure, not the same measure as the overall construction percentage reported in the quarterly filing. <Cite refs={[\"turn361229search3\"]}/>\n\nI also found independent drone footage labelled August 2026, which can help you inspect visible tower progress, but video footage alone cannot verify structural quality, approvals or the work completed inside each tower. <Cite refs={[\"turn361229youtube31\"]}/>\n\n**What this means:** I cannot certify the exact on-site progress as of 15 October 2026 from the records retrieved. Ask the developer for the latest filed quarterly report, a tower-wise progress statement, and a site inspection. Compare those with the approved construction schedule before accepting any payment demand.\n\n## 3. Major legal and land-related issues\n\nThis is the part I would investigate most carefully before booking.\n\n### A. Delhi High Court case involving the promoter\n\nI found a commercial dispute, *Golfgreen Mansions Pvt. Ltd. v. Kinetic Buildtech Pvt. Ltd. & Ors.*, O.M.P.(I) (COMM.) 348/2025.\n\nIn an order dated 27 August 2025, the Delhi High Court recorded allegations concerning competing agreements to transfer shares and management control of Kinetic Buildtech Pvt. Ltd., which held leasehold rights over Plot GH-3B in Sector 10, Greater Noida. The court granted interim protection, including a restraint against alienating or encumbering that particular plot. <Cite refs={[\"turn824355search1\"]}/>\n\nA subsequent Delhi High Court cause list dated 29 May 2026 shows the case was listed alongside an application filed in 2026. I could not verify the final outcome or the latest operative directions from the records retrieved. <Cite refs={[\"turn234774search4\"]}/>\n\n**Does this put Elite X's land at risk?**\n\nNot automatically. Elite X is registered at **Plot GH-03A**, whereas the order identifies **Plot GH-3B**. I have not found evidence establishing that the disputed plot is the Elite X project land. The case is a reason to investigate, not proof that Elite X's title is defective.\n\n### B. What does the land record say about Elite X?\n\nThe project documents include a draft sub-lease deed stating that a 90-year lease of Plot GH-03A, measuring 22,000 square metres, was granted to Golfgreen Mansions Pvt. Ltd. from 9 June 2023. <Cite refs={[\"turn234774search6\"]}/>\n\nThis means the project land is described as **leasehold, not freehold**, in that document. Leasehold ownership is common in planned developments, but the lease terms and compliance with them matter.\n\nBefore booking, have your lawyer verify:\n\n- The executed and registered lease deed, rather than relying on the draft.\n- The chain of title and the Greater Noida Authority's allotment and transfer permissions.\n- Whether any mortgage, charge, encumbrance or outstanding authority dues affect GH-03A.\n- Whether the authority has approved the exact buildings, commercial component and unit you intend to purchase.\n- Whether any court order, lender consent or contractual restriction affects the project land.\n\nUP-RERA lists an encumbrance disclosure among the documents filed for Elite X. That is a document to examine, not proof that the land is free of encumbrances. <Cite refs={[\"turn824355view0\"]}/>\n\n## 4. Summary of what is verified\n\n| Check | Finding |\n|---|---|\n| RERA registration | Registered, number UPRERAPRJ916631/02/2024 |\n| Declared completion | 12 December 2028 |\n| Latest verified quarterly progress | 30.21%, April–June 2026 |\n| Later construction claim | Developer reported 42% structural progress in July 2026 |\n| Major litigation found | Commercial dispute involving the promoter and a different Sector 10 plot |\n| Elite X land directly implicated in that order | Not established |\n| Land tenure | Project document describes a 90-year lease |\n| Clean title and encumbrance status | Not independently established |\n\n## My recommendation before you pay\n\nI would ask the developer for the **latest quarterly progress report, executed lease deed, current encumbrance statement and a written declaration of pending litigation affecting Plot GH-03A**. Have your own property lawyer verify these against the Greater Noida Authority's records and the current court docket.\n\nGiven your ₹2 crore budget and the fact that the declared completion date falls after your preferred move-in deadline, I would not make a substantial payment until both the land documentation and delivery schedule have been independently checked.\n\nThe most important unresolved question is not whether a court case exists somewhere in the builder's history. It is whether **any current legal, financial or approval issue affects the exact land and apartment you would be buying**."
                ]
            },

                    "fallbackMarkdown": "## 1\\. RERA registration and approved completion date\n\n## Elite X\n\nUP-RERA registered residential project\n\n(Registered)\n\n---\n\nRegistration number\n\n### UPRERAPRJ916631/02/2024\n\nRegistration date\n\n### 24 February 2024\n\nDeclared completion\n\n### 12 December 2028\n\nRegistered promoter\n\n### Golfgreen Mansions Pvt. Ltd.\n\nSource: official UP-RERA project record. citeturn824355view0\n\nurlVerify on the official UP-RERA websitehttps://www.up-rera.in/\n\nThe project is registered, and its public record currently shows a declared completion date of **12 December 2028**\\. That is the date on the record I checked; I did not find evidence in the retrieved official record of a later approved extension for Elite X. citeturn824355view0turn824355search2\n\nRegistration is a useful legal starting point, but it does not independently establish that the land is free of all disputes, that every approval remains valid, or that the developer will deliver on time.\n\n## 2\\. Current construction status\n\nThe latest quarterly progress figures I could verify from filings on record were for April–June 2026.\n\nReported construction progress\n\n# 30.21%\n\nApril–June 2026 filing Q2 2026\n\nSource: quarterly progress information compiled from UP-RERA filings. citeturn824355view1\n\nThe developer's website separately claims that the structure was approximately 42% complete in July 2026. That is a developer-published figure, not the same measure as the overall construction percentage reported in the quarterly filing. citeturn361229search3\n\nI also found independent drone footage labelled August 2026, which can help you inspect visible tower progress, but video footage alone cannot verify structural quality, approvals or the work completed inside each tower. citeturn361229youtube31\n\n**What this means\\:** I cannot certify the exact on-site progress as of 15 October 2026 from the records retrieved. Ask the developer for the latest filed quarterly report, a tower-wise progress statement, and a site inspection. Compare those with the approved construction schedule before accepting any payment demand.\n\n## 3\\. Major legal and land-related issues\n\nThis is the part I would investigate most carefully before booking.\n\n### A. Delhi High Court case involving the promoter\n\nI found a commercial dispute, *Golfgreen Mansions Pvt. Ltd. v. Kinetic Buildtech Pvt. Ltd. &amp; Ors.*, O.M.P.(I) (COMM.) 348/2025.\n\nIn an order dated 27 August 2025, the Delhi High Court recorded allegations concerning competing agreements to transfer shares and management control of Kinetic Buildtech Pvt. Ltd., which held leasehold rights over Plot GH-3B in Sector 10, Greater Noida. The court granted interim protection, including a restraint against alienating or encumbering that particular plot. citeturn824355search1\n\nA subsequent Delhi High Court cause list dated 29 May 2026 shows the case was listed alongside an application filed in 2026. I could not verify the final outcome or the latest operative directions from the records retrieved. citeturn234774search4\n\n**Does this put Elite X's land at risk?**\n\nNot automatically. Elite X is registered at **Plot GH-03A**, whereas the order identifies **Plot GH-3B**\\. I have not found evidence establishing that the disputed plot is the Elite X project land. The case is a reason to investigate, not proof that Elite X's title is defective.\n\n### B. What does the land record say about Elite X?\n\nThe project documents include a draft sub-lease deed stating that a 90-year lease of Plot GH-03A, measuring 22,000 square metres, was granted to Golfgreen Mansions Pvt. Ltd. from 9 June 2023. citeturn234774search6\n\nThis means the project land is described as **leasehold, not freehold**, in that document. Leasehold ownership is common in planned developments, but the lease terms and compliance with them matter.\n\nBefore booking, have your lawyer verify\\:\n\n- The executed and registered lease deed, rather than relying on the draft.\n- The chain of title and the Greater Noida Authority's allotment and transfer permissions.\n- Whether any mortgage, charge, encumbrance or outstanding authority dues affect GH-03A.\n- Whether the authority has approved the exact buildings, commercial component and unit you intend to purchase.\n- Whether any court order, lender consent or contractual restriction affects the project land.\n\nUP-RERA lists an encumbrance disclosure among the documents filed for Elite X. That is a document to examine, not proof that the land is free of encumbrances. citeturn824355view0\n\n## 4\\. Summary of what is verified\n\n| Check | Finding |\n|--------|--------|\n| RERA registration | Registered, number UPRERAPRJ916631/02/2024 |\n| Declared completion | 12 December 2028 |\n| Latest verified quarterly progress | 30.21%, April–June 2026 |\n| Later construction claim | Developer reported 42% structural progress in July 2026 |\n| Major litigation found | Commercial dispute involving the promoter and a different Sector 10 plot |\n| Elite X land directly implicated in that order | Not established |\n| Land tenure | Project document describes a 90-year lease |\n| Clean title and encumbrance status | Not independently established |\n\n## My recommendation before you pay\n\nI would ask the developer for the **latest quarterly progress report, executed lease deed, current encumbrance statement and a written declaration of pending litigation affecting Plot GH-03A**\\. Have your own property lawyer verify these against the Greater Noida Authority's records and the current court docket.\n\nGiven your ₹2 crore budget and the fact that the declared completion date falls after your preferred move-in deadline, I would not make a substantial payment until both the land documentation and delivery schedule have been independently checked.\n\nThe most important unresolved question is not whether a court case exists somewhere in the builder's history. It is whether **any current legal, financial or approval issue affects the exact land and apartment you would be buying**\\.",

                                "title": "UP RERA new advisory: 6 key checks homebuyers should do before purchasing property",
                                "snippet": "On May 14, 2026, the Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (UP RERA) issued a new advisory to safeguard homebuyers from potential frauds by builders and developers. The advisory outlines six essential checks that should be completed before buying any property in Uttar Pradesh:\n\n1. Verify the land title and ownership details.\n2. Examine the sanctioned map and layout plan.\n3. Ensure the inventory details provided by the builder match official records.\n4. Check the project's bank account or collection account details.\n5. Review the project's Quarterly Progress Reports (QPRs).\n6.                                     "title": "UP RERA new advisory: 6 key checks homebuyers should do before purchasing property",
                                    "snippet": "On May 14, 2026, the Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (UP RERA) issued a new advisory to safeguard homebuyers from potential frauds by builders and developers. The advisory outlines six essential checks that should be completed before buying any property in Uttar Pradesh:\n\n1. Verify the land title and ownership details.\n2. Examine the sanctioned map and layout plan.\n3. Ensure the inventory details provided by the builder match official records.\n4. Check the project's bank account or collection account details.\n5. Review the project's Quarterly Progress Reports (QPRs).\n6. Investigate the number of complaints previously filed against the builder.\n\nUP RERA encourages homebuyers to use its official online portal to access verified project details and perform these checks efficiently, promoting transparency and accountability in the real estate sector.",

        {
            "id": "16c03033-eda1-4d06-a60b-06fc52e855d8",
            "author": {
                "role": "assistant",
                "name": null,
                "metadata": {}
            },
            "create_time": 1792072037.106283,
            "update_time": 1792072051.891569,
            "content": {
                "content_type": "text",
                "parts": [
                    "**I would not book Elite X today just because a salesperson says prices will rise.** A price increase is only relevant if the apartment is worth buying at today's price, the paperwork checks out, and the payment terms fit your finances.\n\nFor your situation, three things make rushing particularly risky: your ₹2 crore all-in budget, your preference to move in within two years, and the project's declared RERA completion date of 12 December 2028.\n\nThe salesperson may be telling the truth about an upcoming price revision. But even a genuine price increase does not make an unsuitable apartment a good purchase.\n\n## 1. What evidence should you ask the salesperson for?\n\nAsk for documents you can verify independently, not verbal assurances or screenshots without context.\n\n<box gap={3}>\n  <row align=\"start\" gap={3}>\n    <box background=\"surface-secondary\" radius=\"lg\" size=\"44px\" align=\"center\" justify=\"center\">\n      <icon name=\"indian-rupee\" size=\"xl\"/>\n    </box>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      **1. Proof of the proposed price increase**\n\n      Ask for the dated price list currently in force, the proposed revised price list, and the effective date. Ask whether the increase applies to your specific tower, floor, unit and payment plan.\n\n      The official project website currently advertises 3BHK apartments from ₹2.10 crore, excluding GST, stamp duty and registration. It also says prices are indicative and subject to change. <Cite refs={[\"turn707397search0\"]}/>\n\n      An old brochure or a verbal promise that prices will rise next week is not evidence of a confirmed revision.\n    </box>\n  </row>\n  <divider color=\"subtle\"/>\n  <row align=\"start\" gap={3}>\n    <box background=\"surface-secondary\" radius=\"lg\" size=\"44px\" align=\"center\" justify=\"center\">\n      <icon name=\"file-check\" size=\"xl\"/>\n    </box>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      **2. A complete quotation for your exact apartment**\n\n      Get the unit number, carpet area, floor, facing, base price, floor-rise charges, parking, applicable taxes, maintenance deposits and all other charges in writing.\n\n      Request a signed cost sheet and a written explanation of which charges are mandatory. Compare the total cost with at least two comparable properties.\n    </box>\n  </row>\n  <divider color=\"subtle\"/>\n  <row align=\"start\" gap={3}>\n    <box background=\"surface-secondary\" radius=\"lg\" size=\"44px\" align=\"center\" justify=\"center\">\n      <icon name=\"hard-hat\" size=\"xl\"/>\n    </box>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      **3. Evidence of construction progress**\n\n      Ask for the latest UP-RERA quarterly progress report, a tower-wise construction schedule and a site visit. Find out which milestones must be completed before your next payment.\n\n      The publicly reported RERA completion date is 12 December 2028. The developer's July 2026 construction update reported approximately 42% structural progress. Neither figure, by itself, establishes that your flat will be ready by October 2028. <Cite refs={[\"turn707397search0\",\"turn707397search2\"]}/>\n    </box>\n  </row>\n  <divider color=\"subtle\"/>\n  <row align=\"start\" gap={3}>\n    <box background=\"surface-secondary\" radius=\"lg\" size=\"44px\" align=\"center\" justify=\"center\">\n      <icon name=\"scale\" size=\"xl\"/>\n    </box>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      **4. Legal and land documents**\n\n      Have your independent lawyer examine the executed lease deed, current encumbrance details, sanctioned building plans, applicable approvals and the current status of any litigation affecting the project land.\n\n      The promoter's website identifies Tata Capital Housing Finance as a project-finance partner and says the project is mortgaged with it. Ask your lawyer to verify the precise charge, the lender's consent requirements and the release mechanism for your apartment. <Cite refs={[\"turn707397search0\"]}/>\n    </box>\n  </row>\n  <divider color=\"subtle\"/>\n  <row align=\"start\" gap={3}>\n    <box background=\"surface-secondary\" radius=\"lg\" size=\"44px\" align=\"center\" justify=\"center\">\n      <icon name=\"file-text\" size=\"xl\"/>\n    </box>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      **5. Booking and cancellation terms**\n\n      Obtain the booking form, draft agreement for sale, refund policy, cancellation deductions, delay-compensation terms and the complete payment schedule before paying. Ask whether the quoted discount is conditional on a large upfront payment.\n    </box>\n  </row>\n</box>\n\n## 2. What would make me walk away?\n\nI would distinguish between problems that need more investigation and problems that justify stopping the purchase.\n\n<box border radius=\"xl\" padding={3} gap={3}>\n  <row align=\"start\" gap={2}>\n    <icon name=\"circle-x\" color=\"danger\" size=\"xl\"/>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      **Walk away unless resolved**\n\n      - Your independent lawyer identifies a material title defect, an unresolved restriction on sale, or a land dispute directly affecting the apartment.\n      - The developer cannot establish the approvals required for the unit or refuses to provide material legal documents.\n      - You are asked to pay into an unverified account or to pay beyond the legally permitted pre-agreement amount without the required agreement.\n      - The written total price exceeds your hard budget and the seller will not negotiate.\n      - The salesperson will not allow you time for legal review and insists that you transfer money immediately.\n    </box>\n  </row>\n  <divider/>\n  <row align=\"start\" gap={2}>\n    <icon name=\"triangle-alert\" color=\"warning\" size=\"xl\"/>\n    <box flex=\"1\" gap={1}>\n      **Pause until independently verified**\n\n      - The promised price increase has no dated price list or written notice.\n      - Construction progress is materially behind the schedule, with no credible recovery plan.\n      - The lender's mortgage or release conditions for your unit are unclear.\n      - The builder offers a discount only if you make a large early payment.\n      - The salesperson promises possession before the registered date but will not put a credible commitment in the agreement.\n    </box>\n  </row>\n</box>\n\nA builder's refusal to provide documents is a reason to stop the transaction until the issue is resolved. It is not, by itself, proof of fraud. Similarly, a legal case involving a different plot should not be treated as proof that Elite X's land is defective without establishing the connection.\n\n## 3. Does the price make sense for you?\n\nThe developer's currently advertised starting price is ₹2.10 crore before GST, stamp duty and registration. That already exceeds your stated ₹2 crore total budget. <Cite refs={[\"turn707397search0\"]}/>\n\nUse this quick check before negotiating.\n\n{@body const [quote,setQuote] = DIL.useState(185)}\n{@body const [extra,setExtra] = DIL.useState(15)}\n{@body const [reserve,setReserve] = DIL.useState(5)}\n<box border radius=\"xl\" padding={3} gap={3}>\n  <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Enter your actual quotation. Amounts are in ₹ lakh.</text>\n  <box gap={1}>\n    <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n      <label>Base price</label>\n      <title size=\"md\">₹{quote}L</title>\n    </row>\n    <slider min={160} max={230} step={1} value={quote} onChange={setQuote} marks={[{\"value\":160,\"label\":\"₹1.60 Cr\"},{\"value\":195,\"label\":\"₹1.95 Cr\"},{\"value\":230,\"label\":\"₹2.30 Cr\"}]}/>\n  </box>\n  <box gap={1}>\n    <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n      <label>Taxes and other purchase charges</label>\n      <title size=\"md\">₹{extra}L</title>\n    </row>\n    <slider min={0} max={35} step={1} value={extra} onChange={setExtra} marks={[{\"value\":0,\"label\":\"₹0\"},{\"value\":15,\"label\":\"₹15L\"},{\"value\":35,\"label\":\"₹35L\"}]}/>\n  </box>\n  <box gap={1}>\n    <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n      <label>Interiors and contingency</label>\n      <title size=\"md\">₹{reserve}L</title>\n    </row>\n    <slider min={0} max={20} step={1} value={reserve} onChange={setReserve} marks={[{\"value\":0,\"label\":\"₹0\"},{\"value\":10,\"label\":\"₹10L\"},{\"value\":20,\"label\":\"₹20L\"}]}/>\n  </box>\n  <divider/>\n  <row align=\"center\" justify=\"between\">\n    <box gap={1}>\n      <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">Estimated all-in cost</text>\n      <title size=\"2xl\">₹{(quote+extra+reserve).toFixed(1)}L</title>\n    </box>\n    <badge color={quote+extra+reserve<=200?\"success\":\"danger\"}>{quote+extra+reserve<=200?\"Within ₹2 Cr\":\"Over ₹2 Cr\"}</badge>\n  </row>\n  <text color=\"secondary\" size=\"xs\">Planning estimate only. Replace the assumptions with a complete written quotation. Do not count the same charge twice.</text>\n</box>\n\nIf you cannot bring the full cost within your budget without draining your emergency savings, I would walk away even if the salesperson claims a price revision is imminent.\n\n## 4. Send this message to the salesperson\n\n<WritingBlock id=\"58314\" variant=\"chat_message\">Hi, before I make a booking decision, please share the following for the specific 3BHK unit:\n\n1. The current dated price list and any officially approved upcoming price revision.\n2. A complete, written all-inclusive cost sheet.\n3. The latest UP-RERA quarterly progress report and tower-wise construction status.\n4. The draft agreement for sale, payment schedule, possession terms and cancellation/refund policy.\n5. The relevant land-title, encumbrance and lender-clearance documents for the project.\n\nI am seriously considering the property, but I will need time for an independent legal review and a site visit before making any payment. Please confirm the exact unit and price in writing, including how long the offer remains valid.</WritingBlock>\n\n**My bottom line:** don't let urgency make the decision for you. If the apartment is right, the numbers work, and the documents check out, you can negotiate from an informed position. If the deal only works when you ignore the possession timeline, exceed your budget or skip due diligence, the claimed price increase is not a good reason to proceed."
                ]
            },

Legal and land documents**\n\nHave your independent lawyer examine the executed lease deed, current encumbrance details, sanctioned building plans, applicable approvals and the current status of any litigation affecting the project land.\n\nThe promoter's website identifies Tata Capital Housing Finance as a project-finance partner and says the project is mortgaged with it. Ask your lawyer to verify the precise charge, the lender's consent requirements and the release mechanism for your apartment. citeturn707397search0\n\n---\n\n**5\\. Booking and cancellation terms**\n\nObtain the booking form, draft agreement for sale, refund policy, cancellation deductions, delay-compensation terms and the complete payment schedule before paying. Ask whether the quoted discount is conditional on a large upfront payment.\n\n## 2\\. What would make me walk away?\n\nI would distinguish between problems that need more investigation and problems that justify stopping the purchase.\n\n**Walk away unless resolved**\n\n- Your independent lawyer identifies a material title defect, an unresolved restriction on sale, or a land dispute directly affecting the apartment.\n- The developer cannot establish the approvals required for the unit or refuses to provide material legal documents.\n- You are asked to pay into an unverified account or to pay beyond the legally permitted pre-agreement amount without the required agreement.\n- The written total price exceeds your hard budget and the seller will not negotiate.\n- The salesperson will not allow you time for legal review and insists that you transfer money immediately.\n\n---\n\n**Pause until independently verified**\n\n- The promised price increase has no dated price list or written notice.\n- Construction progress is materially behind the schedule, with no credible recovery plan.\n- The lender's mortgage or release conditions for your unit are unclear.\n- The builder offers a discount only if you make a large early payment.\n- The salesperson promises possession before the registered date but will not put a credible commitment in the agreement.\n\nA builder's refusal to provide documents is a reason to stop the transaction until the issue is resolved. It is not, by itself, proof of fraud. Similarly, a legal case involving a different plot should not be treated as proof that Elite X's land is defective without establishing the connection.\n\n## 3\\. Does the price make sense for you?\n\nThe developer's currently advertised starting price is ₹2.10 crore before GST, stamp duty and registration. That already exceeds your stated ₹2 crore total budget. citeturn707397search0\n\nUse this quick check before negotiating.\n\nEnter your actual quotation. Amounts are in ₹ lakh.\n\nBase price\n\n### ₹L\n\n> **Slider**\n>\n> Current value unavailable.\n>\n> **Range:** 160 to 230\n>\n> **Step:** 1\n>\n> **Scale labels:** 160 — ₹1\\.60 Cr · 195 — ₹1\\.95 Cr · 230 — ₹2\\.30 Cr\n\nTaxes and other purchase charges\n\n### ₹L\n\n> **Slider**\n>\n> Current value unavailable.\n>\n> **Range:** 0 to 35\n>\n> **Step:** 1\n>\n> **Scale labels:** 0 — ₹0 · 15 — ₹15L · 35 — ₹35L\n\nInteriors and contingency\n\n### ₹L\n\n> **Slider**\n>\n> Current value unavailable.\n>\n> **Range:** 0 to 20\n>\n> **Step:** 1\n>\n> **Scale labels:** 0 — ₹0 · 10 — ₹10L · 20 — ₹20L\n\n---\n\nEstimated all-in cost\n\n# ₹L\n\nPlanning estimate only. Replace the assumptions with a complete written quotation. Do not count the same charge twice.\n\nIf you cannot bring the full cost within your budget without draining your emergency savings, I would walk away even if the salesperson claims a price revision is imminent.\n\n## 4\\. Send this message to the salesperson\n\n:::writing{variant=\"chat_message\" id=\"58314\"}\nHi, before I make a booking decision, please share the following for the specific 3BHK unit:\n\n1. The current dated price list and any officially approved upcoming price revision.\n2. A complete, written all-inclusive cost sheet.\n3. The latest UP-RERA quarterly progress report and tower-wise construction status.\n4. The draft agreement for sale, payment schedule, possession terms and cancellation/refund policy.\n5. The relevant land-title, encumbrance and lender-clearance documents for the project.\n\nI am seriously considering the property, but I will need time for an independent legal review and a site visit before making any payment. Please confirm the exact unit and price in writing, including how long the offer remains valid.\n:::\n\n**My bottom line\\:** don't let urgency make the decision for you. If the apartment is right, the numbers work, and the documents check out, you can negotiate from an informed position. If the deal only works when you ignore the possession timeline, exceed your budget or skip due diligence, the claimed price increase is not a good reason to proceed.",
